description:
Fix the build errors in the BrokenApp Android project. The project is already open in Android Studio and has several compilation errors that prevent it from building.

Examine the error messages in the Build output panel and the source code to identify and fix all build errors so the project compiles successfully.

After fixing all errors, rebuild the project using Build > Rebuild Project (or Ctrl+Shift+F9) and verify it compiles without errors.
